sources.name: COMI-LINGUA (Lingo Research Group, IIT Gandhinagar)
sources.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (conservative interpretation; upstream GitHub repository declares CC-BY-SA-4.0)
sources.use: official LID train/test splits; majority vote over human annotator tags

sources.name: PHINC (Parallel Hinglish Social Media Code-Mixed Corpus)
sources.use: Romanized Hinglish source text and human English translations; paired rows split together

sources.name: Tatoeba English-Hindi sentence pairs (ManyThings.org selection)
sources.use: monolingual Hindi and English examples; paired rows split together; attribution retained in DATASET_ATTRIBUTION_TATOEBA.tsv

license: COMI-LINGUA conservatively treated as CC BY-SA 4.0; PHINC CC BY 4.0; Tatoeba CC BY 2.0 France. See DATASET_CARD.md and attribution file.
label_rule: COMI per-annotator: hi ratio >= 80% => hindi; en ratio >= 80% => english; otherwise hinglish; majority vote across human annotators; PHINC source => hinglish and translation => english; Tatoeba pair => hindi/english
cleaning: remove zero-width/BOM characters and collapse whitespace
majority vote across human COMI-LINGUA annotators; discard ties
deduplicate exact case-insensitive text within each combined split
split PHINC and Tatoeba by paired row before expanding labels
remove exact train/test text overlap across all sources

phinc.dataset: PHINC (Parallel Hinglish Social Media Code-Mixed Corpus)
phinc.split_rule: deterministic 80/20 split by paired row; both members of each translation pair stay in the same split

tatoeba.split_rule: deterministic 80/20 split by paired row; English and Hindi sentence pair stay in same split
